title: Setup
description:
#### Note: _This Course has a prerequisit, linux. If you haven't finished that course yet, then do it [here](https://youg-otricked.github.io/learnhardcode/learnlinux/hello.html)_
For windows users

Use WSL. You need to. Get it in the learn linux course if you don't already have it.

## Welcome to learn git! In this course, you will learn git. You will be working for a ficticious cybersecurity, "GetApp" --- Time to install git! It's really simple. On mac, run `brew install git`. If the command is not found, run `/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"`. Then, run `brew install git`. On Ubuntu linux run sudo `apt install git`. --- Now that you have git, you need to install the LearnHardCode CLI. If you already have it, skip this step. This is how you will submit lessons to the course. (Skip if you already have it (`which lhc` prints somthing) To get the CLI, just run: ```bash OS="$(uname -s)" if [ "$OS" = "Darwin" ]; then FILE="lhc-macos" elif [ "$OS" = "Linux" ]; then FILE="lhc-linux" else echo "Unsupported OS: $OS" exit 1 fi curl -L "https://github.com/Youg-Otricked/learnhardcode-cli_and_cli-courses/releases/latest/download/$FILE" -o lhc chmod +x lhc ``` Then run `./lhc setup `, then just `source ~/.bashrc` --- Then, just run ``` lhc help ``` If you see a list of commands you're ready! --- Press the submit button to continue
